narrative.executive_summary: Live scan of 8 missions across retail_clothing has detected a systemic operational threat pattern, all rated MEDIUM severity (risk scores 34-47). The core failure is a phantom replenishment signal: 5 missions flag 129 products requiring immediate replenishment yet recommend 0 units to reorder, effectively disabling automated restocking. This is compounded by acute demand pressure on 30 high-velocity SKUs led by Oil (42 units), Biscuits (30 units) and Mouse (28 units), and by revenue concentration where Mobile World drives INR 102,399 (20% of INR 505,881 total revenue on 213 units) across just 14 sales records. Without immediate logic correction and manual intervention, high-demand stockouts will directly erode revenue within the current sales cycle.

threat_vectors.name: Phantom Replenishment Logic Failure
threat_vectors.description: Five missions (Dead Capital Deep Freeze, Size Curve Distortion, Silent Reorder Point Breach, Margin Erosion, Geographically Stranded Inventory) flag 129 products for urgent replenishment but calculate 0 units to reorder, indicating a critical calculation or data-feed failure that nullifies automated restocking and guarantees lost sales.

threat_vectors.name: High-Velocity Stockout Exposure
threat_vectors.description: 30 high-velocity products show sustained demand led by Oil (42 units), Biscuits (30 units) and Mouse (28 units) with risk score 47 for Chronic Supplier Latency Cascade; any replenishment delay will immediately translate to stockouts on top revenue-driving SKUs.

threat_vectors.name: Channel Revenue Concentration Fragility
threat_vectors.description: Sales across 14 records total INR 505,881 (213 units) with Mobile World alone contributing INR 102,399 (17 units / ~20% of revenue); over-reliance on a single channel amplifies vulnerability to demand collapse and operational disruption.

immediate_actions: Immediately suspend automated reorder logic and audit reorder-quantity engine for all 129 flagged SKUs (21+36+15+36+21) — correct formula/data-feed error and issue emergency manual purchase orders within 24 hours, prioritizing Oil (42 units), Biscuits (30) and Mouse (28).

Conduct physical inventory verification and allocate safety stock for top 30 high-velocity SKUs, ensuring minimum 14-day cover for Oil, Biscuits, Mouse and Sugar (23 units) to prevent imminent stockout.
Initiate supplier latency review for suppliers serving the top 15 concentration-risk products and activate secondary/alternate-country suppliers to de-risk single-supplier dependency.

De-risk channel concentration by accelerating demand generation and inventory allocation to underperforming channels and securing contingency fulfillment agreements to reduce Mobile World's 20% revenue dependency.
monitoring_recommendations: Deploy real-time dashboard tracking reorder-point breach vs. recommended quantity with instant alert on any 'breach with 0 units' anomaly; review daily for 30 days until logic is validated.
Implement weekly velocity monitoring for top 30 SKUs with automated alerts when inventory cover falls below 14 days of sales for Oil, Biscuits, Mouse and Sugar.

Establish weekly channel health scorecard monitoring revenue share, unit velocity and transaction count per channel; flag if any single channel exceeds 25% of total revenue or shows >15% week-over-week decline.
